updateIssueRecord.reason: Bounded mode replaces the PagedWorkspaceMetadata/handoff read with boundedIssueUpdateTargets (owned literal projection of policy fields and live directory, projected project/cycle lookups) or, without authentication, boundedIssueUpdatePresence (installed ID lookups); the off branch is literal. The callback is unchanged: issueRole reads the projected viewer, role, teams, settings and memberships with the writer's issues, and applyUpdate/moveIssueToTeam/notifications read the bounded UpdateIssueRecord closure (selected users, labels with same-named move labels, states, cycles, SLA rules of both teams, attached documents, issueMoveAudience members, owned editor lookups). TestScaleP21IssueUpdate{Fields,TeamMove,Scheduler,Concurrent,Inline,StoreBoundaries,WithoutAuth}: legacy/warm/SQL-reloaded byte-exact responses, rows, sequence, aliases, documents, collaboration updates, activity (including merged update entries), notifications and their audience, events with previous values, webhooks and realtime. Independent blockers remain: issueRecordsQuery and the request authorization middleware (buildIssueRecordAuthorizationData) for this route, and UpdateIssueRecord's ContentState (CRDT snapshot) boundary.
